author: ElementalAssasin
body: I understand that death threats are very bad and may influence others of this very nice community but not when your just around a bunch of friends just joking around, sure it may not be good to do it around and i may be doing it at public matches for all you know so you can't trust me going around not learning my lesson and as my proof states it seems like i meant to do it on purpose or because i was angry. But we call each other twats and like have bants like each day so i meant to do more as a funny thing we all even went after that like YE ITS A THREAT because it was meant jokingly as a ban didn't really mean it or anything. Like Turfs (armoredwhale) is a amazing player and amazing defender so I never meant it so as a rude insult or anything I just meant it as a joke nothing here was meant to be on purpose you would even see  earlier on the evidence of how I was just joking around I never meant it get so out of hand. Now I'm going to make evidence to show it IS banter just from my teammates responses.  http://imgur.com/a/MZB0n  they all meant it as a joke just from Andrew (armoredcarrot) saying accusations to get me banned and his response after wasn't like ok finally he got banned or something similar he had a shock and faint reaction just from me getting banned.
